title: Vice President - Corporate Sector Coverage
full_description:
ING Australia’s Wholesale Bank is looking to hire a Vice President - Corporate Sector Coverage to be based in Sydney.Responsible for supporting the Head of Corporate Sector Coverage across all aspects of the portfolio, this position will play an in important role in the development and execution of a growth strategy for CSC AU in line with regional CSC Sector and wider Wholesale Bank growth aspirations.As Vice President CSC, you will have a passion for commercial excellence in providing coverage support to CSC clients. Responsibilities include origination and business development; building and developing new client relationships; driving new business development initiatives; and maximising the delivery of all products to clients and hence revenue and profitability on a per client basis. You will work closely with the Head Office CSC and other sector and product colleagues both in Sydney and across ING’s global network.We are looking for an entrepreneurial, self-starting banker who has strong analytical, numerical, written and oral communication skills who can work collaboratively with others. You will need to have relevant sector and corporate banking experience (ideally from within a global banking environment) and a good credit, structuring and analytical grounding.Ready to make an impact?What you’ll do
Working with local and global team members including product partners, sector teams, Risk and other stakeholders to originate new business with clients, ongoing client relationship management, execute new deals and monitor / maintain existing portfolio.
Prospecting for new clients, working on pitches and proposals to position the ING Differentiators, developing and managing detailed client plans, assisting with industry/sector reviews and strategy, assisting with deal structuring, coordinating internal approval process, legal documentation and other execution matters on transactions with support teams in place
Helping to cross-sell the bank’s other products and services such as financial markets, debt capital markets, loan syndications, acquisition finance, transaction services and corporate finance advisory. Oversight of credit reviews and assisting with portfolio maintenance/monitoring and portfolio administrative activity as required but with support teams in place
Developing marketing material and maintaining a current view of recent transactions, market benchmarks, economic and industry trends, and gathering relevant research. Marketing materials include pitch books, industry reports, comparative tables and league tables as well as updating relevant credentials.
What we’re looking for
5-7 years’ relevant working experience in banking industry with strong business track record
University degree major in business/economics or relevant business discipline
Positive thinker/resilience in implementing the strategy
Self-motivated, entrepreneurial with a high degree of commercial drive and initiative to
Ability to navigate the bank quickly and successfully excelling in a matrix environment
Ability to collaborate closely with product partners, particularly treasury, corporate finance and capital markets
Excellent team player
Strong English language capabilities (both spoken and written)
What’s in it for you?
Discounted ING Health Insurance
An additional Rest Day to support your wellbeing
An IMPACT day to volunteer on approved sustainability activity
At ING, we’re all about making life simpler and more rewarding - for the people who bank with us, the team members who work with us, and the communities we’re proud to support. Joining ING means stepping into an environment where your individuality isn’t just welcomed - it’s celebrated. We’ve built a culture that’s fun, inclusive, and supportive, giving you the freedom to be yourself, so you can do your thing.
Whether you’re taking ownership of exciting projects, thinking outside the box, or working with global colleagues, you’ll find ING is the kind of place where growth isn’t just a possibility; it’s a promise. As a WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality and Family Inclusive workplace, you’ll feel the difference in how we value and champion our people.
We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities, and how you align with our values - not on ticking every box. So, if you’re interested but don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply. We’re invested in fostering adiverse and inclusive workplacewhere everyone feels like they belong. We’re your allies in helping you do your thing during the recruitment process, so let us know (email below) if you require any support or adjustments when you apply
Sound like your kind of vibe? We can’t wait to hear from you!
(One last note: We operate using a direct talent sourcing model, so no agency introductions, please.)
ING is Australia’s most recommended bank according to RFI Global’s Consumer Atlas Survey, January–June 2025 (n = 29,510) when compared to customers of the 10 largest ADIs operating in Australia.
Contact: Mark Montgomerymark.montgomery@ing.com
For support and adjustments, including DEI, LGBTQI+ confidential application support enquiries: rpoteam.au@ing.com
